Crypto.com Sponsors Football Match
Cryptocurrency exchange platform Crypto.com, often described as being one of the most noob-friendly exchanges, has moved into football sponsorships. The company is sponsoring the final of Coppa Italia, an Italian football tournament. They had previously sponsored sporting events and teams, namely the Aston Martin Formula One team. To mark the significant sponsorship, Crypto.com is releasing a limited set of non-fungible tokens. The line will include things like the tournament's trophy. >>Source


Toei Animation Europe Briefly Lists New Dragon Ball Super Movie
For a brief moment we received an exciting headline by Toei Animation Europe on it's news website. "Toei Animation Marks Goku Day With Surprise Announcement of New Dragon Ball Super Movie in 2022.". The healine is not listed on the website anymore and the link posted with the healine goes to a 404 error page. The headline listing is still available via a Bing cache. "Goku Day" is on May 9, as the numbers 5 and 9 can be read in Japanese as "Go" and "Ku" respectively. >>Source

Kaguya-sama: Love is War OVA's Promo Video Teases Swimsuit Episode
A new promotional video for the upcomind three-episode original video anime for the anime of Aka Akasaka's Kaguya-sama: Love is War (Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunōsen) manga was streamed on Friday bu the official Twitter account for the anime. >>Source



Pokémon's 24th Anime Season Pokémon Master Journeys Premieres This Summer
It was announced on Thursday that the 24th season of the Pokémon franchise's anime, Pokémon Master Journeys: The Series, will premiere "as early as summer" by the Pokémon Company International.




The Pokémon Company describes the new season:
It's a big, big world, but you know where to find Ash and Goh—battling and catching Pokémon from Kanto to Galar! With Pikachu, Cinderace, and their other Pokémon beside them, our heroes continue to travel all over the world to research Pokémon for Cerise Laboratory. Along the way, Ash climbs higher in the World Coronation Series rankings, and Goh adds more Pokémon to his Pokédex in his quest to catch Mew. Meanwhile, Chloe takes her first steps as a Pokémon Trainer when she meets a mysterious Eevee. New friends, returning rivals, and exciting adventures await—as the journey continues! >>Source
